verdict.rationale: Receipts are a core axis for a POS product, but the evidence pack never mentions issuing email, SMS or printed receipts, or meeting card-network receipt requirements. The related items, emailing customers about unpurchased items and printing shipping labels, are adjacent features, not receipts.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements
